So the carts are aimed at the diamonds. Maybe clicking a cart makes it move toward the diamond (like a laser/shoot?). But clicking the green cart's body/dot did nothing.
Hmm, wait — maybe I clicked the wrong cell. The green cart's red dot is at (10,31). I clicked (10,30) then (10,31). Neither worked.
Maybe the interaction is: click the diamond first (to activate the target), then click the cart? Or click the cart's gray nub (the "handle")?
